# DiagnosticsCollector

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Collects diagnostics during PDF generation. The Document owns one instance for the lifetime of a `generateBytes*()` call; subsystems push diagnostics into it instead of calling `console.warn` directly, so the library never writes to a global sink the caller did not opt into.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new DiagnosticsCollector()
```

## Properties

- [`all`](#all): Every diagnostic collected so far, in the order it was added.
- [`count`](#count): The number of diagnostics collected so far.

### `all`

```typescript
readonly all: readonly IDiagnostic[]
```

*read-only*

Every diagnostic collected so far, in the order it was added.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`.

### `count`

```typescript
readonly count: number
```

*read-only*

The number of diagnostics collected so far.

## Methods

- [`add`](#add): Adds a diagnostic to the collection.
- [`addError`](#adderror): Adds an error-severity diagnostic with the given category, message, optional source and underlying cause.
- [`addInfo`](#addinfo): Adds an informational diagnostic with the given category, message and optional source.
- [`addWarning`](#addwarning): Adds a warning-severity diagnostic with the given category, message, optional source and underlying cause.
- [`clear`](#clear): Removes every collected diagnostic.
- [`hasErrors`](#haserrors): Returns `true` when at least one error-severity diagnostic has been collected.
- [`hasWarnings`](#haswarnings): Returns `true` when at least one warning-severity diagnostic has been collected.
- [`print`](#print): Writes each collected diagnostic to the appropriate console method (`console.error` / `console.warn` / `console.info`).

### `print`

```typescript
print(): void
```

Writes each collected diagnostic to the appropriate console method (`console.error` / `console.warn` / `console.info`). This is a convenience for callers who just want the messages surfaced; library code never calls this implicitly.
